generation.stylePrompt: Anime-forward 2.5D, drawn ink contours, flat cel-shadow planes, expressive stylized face, painted environment depth. Preserve copper curls with pale temple strands, warm dark brown skin, amber eyes, rectangular earrings, iron collar, burgundy-black judicial coat and ivory neckcloth. Iron-faceted jaw/neck and ember fissures reinforce infernal identity. Magma: colossal basalt weights and crushed wasted gold. Normal anatomy, no text, no extra targets, no generic soldiers.

scenes.portrait: Asset: portrait. Exactly ONE character, Magistrada only. Tight chest-up three-quarter view as she turns her head in cold contempt, one shoulder higher, slight high camera looking across her gaze. Behind her, deep out-of-focus ash-gray weigh pits with immense hovering square basalt weights and crushed gold in narrow seams. Copper curls silhouette clear. Black, burgundy and muted brass palette with pale ash light. Hands outside frame.
scenes.passive: Asset: passive Lei do Mais Forte. Exactly TWO figures: Magistrada and ONE lean unarmored gray ghoul enemy. Wide side-on action at middle distance. She has just hit the exposed ghoul with a short blunt rectangular iron judicial baton; ghoul staggers backward, a small sharp crimson vulnerability fissure glows on its chest. A SINGLE ivory enemy essence spark breaks and extinguishes beside the ghoul, while two small overlapping iron guard plates settle beside Magistrada's shoulder. This visualizes striking an exposed enemy, gaining a little defense and destroying an enemy reserve spark, not healing or absorbing life. Location: ash-swept ledge under giant suspended basalt weight. Clear full-body silhouettes and small hands.
scenes.skill-impulso: Asset: Acusação Imposta, single-target physical attack applying exposure and sealing support. Exactly TWO figures: Magistrada and ONE lean unarmored ghoul. Low oblique action composition: she drives her short block-headed iron baton into the ghoul's shoulder; a small angular crimson iron brand fractures open on its upper chest, while a single pale attempted support ribbon behind that SAME target is pinched shut by an angular iron clasp. Keep clear physical contact and bodily recoil. Location: sloped floor of a colossal abandoned weighing basin littered with flattened gold, no other bodies. Her right hand grips baton naturally, keep hand small and partly hidden by baton guard.
scenes.skill-tecnica: Asset: Interdição da Defesa, one enemy stunned and defense broken. Exactly TWO figures: Magistrada and ONE unarmored ash ghoul. Eye-level lateral action on a narrow basalt causeway over a gold-crushing pit. Magistrada sweeps her iron baton across the ghoul's raised translucent angular shield; shield splits into a few broad chunks, ghoul crumples to one knee, head bowed and stunned. Baton and right wrist aligned, normal anatomy, faces in profile and medium distance. This is a single defense-breaking strike, no group, no extra victims. Dust and fabric motion support the action.
scenes.skill-voto: Asset: Sentença de Submissão, concentrated piercing damage to one exposed enemy. Exactly TWO figures: Magistrada and ONE unarmored ghoul. Dramatic elevated diagonal view, long compressed perspective showing her in near-left MIDGROUND and the target across a cracked basalt weighing platform. She points her iron baton level at the exposed target; a single narrow spear-shaped wedge of black iron edged in pale amber shoots through the ghoul's brittle guard toward its torso, visible impact and one red vulnerability fissure, non-graphic. No multiplying missiles, no area attack, no other people. Her robe and curls bend in same blast direction. Gold flattened under massive distant weights.
scenes.skill-despertar: Asset: Toga Inviolável, personal invulnerability. Exactly ONE character: Magistrada alone. Full figure from rear three-quarter at middle distance, moving steadily across a field of crushed coin-disks and ash while turning her amber eye toward viewer. Her actual dark burgundy toga flares into a close-fitting angular mantle of overlapping iron shadow planes, shielding her body. Falling small basalt debris glances off the mantle in white sparks. No bubble, no halo, no sphere, no allies, no enemies, no combat targets. A colossal stone weight hangs far above, strong negative space and pale ash fog, asymmetrical scene.

Turn Magistrada's face into clear right-facing profile, chin slightly down. Both eyes focus on the kneeling ghoul and the shattering shield immediately to the right, following the extended baton. No pupil aimed at camera. Eyes and head must visibly participate in this strike.
